subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 6/7] mountd/exportd: always give pseudo-root directories a path-based uuid

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch ensures that pseudo-root directories in the NFSv4 export system always receive a path-based UUID, rather than relying on the filesystem's own UUID. This change addresses issues where the filesystem's UUID was being used temporarily during an exportfs run, leading to inconsistent filehandles. The patch also fixes a bug where the uuid_s variable was going out of scope too early, causing a crash. By always using a path-based UUID for pseudo-root directories, this patch aligns with existing behavior and improves the stability of the NFSv4 export system.
